verdict.rationale: Phaser is a JavaScript/TypeScript framework, and its public programmatic API is documented. The docs cover the Scene, Loader, Animation Manager, physics and Game Object APIs with code examples such as this.add.sprite, and full TypeScript definitions ship for editor and agent discovery. Phaser also offers a hosted examples API (GET /api/v1/examples/{id} indexed via llms.txt) and an official MCP server with 40+ tools for agent-driven use. Missing for 10: no comprehensive API reference evidenced in the pack, OpenAPI specs and docs llms.txt/markdown endpoints return 404, the phaser.io root blocks non-browser clients, and community reports call the docs weak (though these reports are dated).
